sources.description: Invented Atlas, Bridge, Ledger, Echo, Harbor and Portal engineering examples; no live incident or customer data.

label_policy: Grade 2 direct answer or constraint; grade 1 concrete actionable partial; topic overlap alone grade 0. Labels fixed before scores.
limitations: Small synthetic coding-domain dev set; no representativeness or task-level utility claim.

case_rationales.p01: The record directly names PostgreSQL 16 and pgvector.
case_rationales.p02: Separate English schedule and retention records each provide one useful part of the combined answer.
case_rationales.p03: Exact drill-log path is an actionable clue; the actual latest result is absent.
case_rationales.p04: Bearer token and project context header are explicit.
case_rationales.p05: Retry count and dead-letter action jointly answer the workflow.
case_rationales.p06: Global EUR policy answers; beta USD record is foreign to alpha.
case_rationales.p07: Sample rate, channels and container are explicit.
case_rationales.p08: Revision 2 says 5 percent; old revision and beta project are inadmissible.
case_rationales.p09: Retry-After is the concrete response constraint.
case_rationales.p10: English memory states RRF k=60 exactly.
case_rationales.p12: URL query-string state directly answers; typo-tolerant source path is a concrete partial clue.
case_rationales.p13: invoice_id is the exact English record identifier.
case_rationales.p14: Russian memory directly states ru-RU default.
case_rationales.p15: Policy gives three retries; procedure has a different memory_type.
case_rationales.p16: Alpha project record directly names the URL query string.
case_rationales.n01: Nightly schedule and retention say nothing about the latest backup success; no backup-status location is given.
case_rationales.n02: Authentication controls contain no person or rota assignment.
case_rationales.n03: Retry rules and queue-depth metric do not identify any failed job at the stated time.
case_rationales.n04: Tax jurisdiction and currency do not determine an approved rate.
case_rationales.n05: Format, hints and logs contain no evaluation result.
case_rationales.n06: Canary percentage and rollback rule give no start timestamp.
case_rationales.n07: 429 response policy gives no observed incident count.
case_rationales.n08: Embedding profile name is not a tokenizer revision.
case_rationales.n09: Route and state notes do not describe any crash date.
case_rationales.n10: CI stage policy contains no measured duration.
case_rationales.n11: Encryption-at-rest and auth signing-key rotation do not state backup-key rotation.
case_rationales.n12: Browser session inactivity TTL is a different credential lifecycle.
case_rationales.n13: No office facilities record exists in the corpus.
case_rationales.n14: No cafeteria or menu record exists in the corpus.
